selection_policy: After all five single-change runs, combine the best-scoring feature with features whose traces demonstrate a mechanical benefit without a new blocking failure. Resolve ties using lower malformed-action count, then lower token usage. Never use hidden grader content or task-specific solution hints. Preserve all runs; declare a win only for more than five passes.
development_policy: All five implementations frozen before scoring. New tests use unrelated synthetic fixtures. Endpoint probes are outside the scored suite. No post-score implementation tuning.
